nodes.description: Mapping address => uint256 holding token balances, read and written by transfer, transferFrom, balanceOf and the constructor.
Nested mapping address => address => uint256 of spending allowances, written by approve/approveAndCall and consumed by transferFrom/allowance.
Public total token supply, assigned once inside the ERC20Token constructor.
Public token name string set to 'Rainbow Token'.
Public number of decimals (18) used for display only.
Public token symbol set to 'RNBO'.
Public version string 'H1.1'.
StandardToken.transfer: checks balances[msg.sender] >= _value && _value > 0, then mutates balances with unchecked subtraction/addition and emits Transfer.
StandardToken.transferFrom: checks balance, allowance and _value > 0, then mutates balances and allowed with unchecked arithmetic.
StandardToken.approve: writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emits Approval.
ERC20Token.approveAndCall: sets allowance then performs an external call to _spender with receiveApproval selector, reverting on failure.
StandardToken.balanceOf: constant getter returning balances[_owner].
StandardToken.allowance: constant getter returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
ERC20Token constructor: mints initial balances[msg.sender] and sets totalSupply, name, decimals and symbol.
ERC20Token fallback function that throws on any plain ether transfer.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and forwarded argument to the external call.
balances[msg.sender] -= _value in transfer, unchecked integer subtraction.
balances[_to] += _value in transfer, unchecked integer addition allowing balance wrap.
balances[_to] += _value in transferFrom, unchecked integer addition.
balances[_from] -= _value in transferFrom, unchecked integer subtraction.
allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom, unchecked allowance subtraction.
_spender.call(receiveApproval selector, msg.sender, _value, this, _extraData) performed on an arbitrary, caller-supplied contract.
throw statement in the fallback function reverting any incoming ether.
Recipient address parameter _to of transfer.
Amount parameter _value used by transfer, transferFrom, approve and approveAndCall.
Source address parameter _from of transferFrom.
Spender address parameter _spender used by approve, allowance and approveAndCall.
Owner address parameter _owner used by balanceOf and allowance.
Arbitrary bytes parameter _extraData forwarded in the approveAndCall external call.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used to read and debit balances[msg.sender] inside transfer, so the authorization depends on the caller identity.
transferFrom consumes allowed[_from][msg.sender], making the spender allowance fully caller-controlled.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller as allowance owner.
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] and forwards msg.sender to the external call.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping for _from and _to.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowed allowance mapping.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
balanceOf returns the value stored in the balances mapping.
allowance returns the value stored in the allowed mapping.
The constructor assigns the whole initial supply to balances[msg.sender] without any access restriction.
The constructor assigns the initial totalSupply value.
transfer performs balances[msg.sender] -= _value with no SafeMath protection.
transfer performs balances[_to] += _value with no overflow check, enabling balance wrap on addition.
transferFrom performs balances[_to] += _value with no overflow check.
transferFrom performs balances[_from] -= _value with no SafeMath protection.
transferFrom performs allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value with no underflow protection.
approveAndCall invokes an arbitrary external contract via a low-level call, creating a callback into untrusted code.
msg.sender is passed as an argument into the untrusted external call, letting the caller influence the callback target and payload.
The fallback function unconditionally executes throw for any plain ether transfer.
Parameter _to is credited with the transferred amount inside transfer.
Parameter _value drives the balance arithmetic of transfer.
Parameter _from is debited and checked in transferFrom.
Parameter _value drives the balance and allowance arithmetic of transferFrom.
Parameter _spender is the allowance beneficiary written by approve.
Parameter _value is the allowance amount stored by approve.
Parameter _owner indexes the balances lookup in balanceOf.
Parameter _owner indexes the allowed lookup in allowance.
Parameter _spender indexes the allowed lookup in allowance.
Parameter _spender is both the allowance beneficiary and the external call target in approveAndCall.
Parameter _value is the allowance amount and forwarded call argument in approveAndCall.
Parameter _extraData is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to only feeds the transfer recipient balance update and should be folded into the transfer function node.
Parameter _value is the amount operand of the unchecked balance arithmetic in transfer and is normalized into that function.
Parameter _from is only used as the debited account inside transferFrom.
Parameter _spender is only used as the allowance beneficiary written by approve.
Parameter _owner is only used as the lookup key in balanceOf.
Parameter _extraData is only used as the forwarded payload of the approveAndCall external call.
